scope: Human and automatic routing decisions for public-facing machine translation
does_not_establish: This map is a bounded inspiration artifact, not a research-gap, prevalence, novelty, or lifecycle certificate.

sources.title: European Commission use of eTranslation

inspection_spans.observation: Raw MT is used when human translation is unavailable, with variable quality by text and language pair.

sources.supports: An operational, multilingual public-service workflow with explicit output limitations.
sources.does_not_establish: Outcome frequency or the best decision interface.

sources.title: Quality Gate: Estimating the Quality of Machine Translation for Public Administration Use Cases

inspection_spans.observation: A quality gate routes MT or human review, with threshold trade-offs varying by language and use case.

sources.title: Supporting User Reliance on Machine Translation via Implicit and Explicit Feedback

inspection_spans.observation: Feedback form changes decision accuracy and reliance, under narrow language/domain/error conditions.

tension_clusters.label: Public workflows expose variable-quality raw MT while consequential use requires fit-for-purpose judgment
tension_clusters.incumbent_practice: Expose raw MT when human translation is unavailable, or route by an estimated quality threshold.
tension_clusters.material_consequence: Misleading public information, inappropriate user reliance, or unnecessary human-review cost.
tension_clusters.candidate_construct: Decision-calibrated translation routing and feedback conditioned on language, use case, and user agency.
alternative_explanations: Underlying MT quality is insufficient regardless of interface
Presentation and decision support, rather than translation quality alone, drive the observed reliance
Human disagreement makes a single threshold ill-posed
tension_clusters.does_not_establish: A research gap, prevalence, novelty, or a universal threshold.

controller_boundary: Review-only map; it cannot mutate subject state or authorize a proposal.
